name: Budak Imbiss
kurzbeschreibung:
**Budak Imbiss in Tirol**

Discover the authentic flavors of **Budak Imbiss** in the heart of **Tirol**! This beloved spot serves up delicious Turkish street food with a cozy, welcoming vibe. Sink your teeth into a juicy **Döner Kebap**, savor a crispy **Schnitzel**, or indulge in a warm **Börek**—all made with fresh, high-quality ingredients.

Whether you're strolling through **Innsbruck**, exploring the **Zillertal**, or taking a break in **Kufstein**, **Budak Imbiss** is the perfect place to refuel. Their generous portions and friendly service make every visit unforgettable.

Don’t miss their famous **Lahmacun** or a hearty **Kebap mit Pommes**—simple, satisfying, and always a hit. Pair your meal with a cold **Ayran** or a refreshing **Fanta** for the full experience.

**Budak Imbiss**—where tradition meets taste in the mountains of **Tirol**!
